caption: The drawing depicts a small dog with brown and white fur sitting on a red cushion that has a yellow border. The dog has a short snout and pointed ears, and its face is directed toward the viewer. The cushion is placed on a green oval mat. Behind the dog, there are two flowering plants: one with blue blossoms and green foliage on the left, and one with pink flowers and green leaves on the right. The background is divided horizontally, with the lower part consisting of a gray surface representing the floor, and the upper part showing a brown wall. The entire scene is rendered in a cross-stitch style with visible grid patterns and colored threads.
title: Needlepoint Dog
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
